upstream_references.use: Research only; no backend source bundled

upstream_references.changes: Extract SHA1 six-digit TOTP generation; strict Base32/otpauth validation; reject enrollment, rotation, nondefault TOTP parameters; injectable test clock. The protocol login engine is not bundled.

upstream_references.use: Existing-account protocol behavior reimplemented in reference-flow.mjs; official browser supplies JavaScript, cookies, network and human-verification boundary. No Go runtime, TLS fingerprint engine, challenge solver, registration or MFA enrollment code copied.

playwright-core.modifications: None. Worker configures child_process.spawn within its own process to retain the host-owned process group.

node.packaging: Explicit local executable and matching license; executable SHA-256 recorded per installed manifest.

browser.packaging: Not bundled or downloaded. Explicit installed Chromium executable required; exact executable SHA-256 and version recorded per installed manifest.

verification: Offline dual-origin login including shared operation device identity, authenticated existing-session continuation and precise JSON/HTTP website-check classification, alongside password/TOTP/host-OAuth and scoped request tests. Real account outcome remains distinct from fixture results.
